experience.text: I designed websites in Figma and built them as custom WordPress themes with PHP and ACF. I worked on projects from the first design to launch, made sure they worked on every screen size, and set them up so clients could edit their own content.
I built and maintained WordPress websites with Elementor, tested sites, fixed bugs and helped with designs. I also joined client meetings and talked to clients about the changes they wanted.
I did IT support. I answered questions from users, fixed technical problems and worked with my colleagues to solve them.

about.text:
I like both designing and coding. It's fun to design something in Figma and then be able to click through it in the browser.

During my internships I worked on website design, WordPress development, testing and maintenance. I also worked with clients directly, which taught me how to build something for someone else instead of for myself.

Right now I like frontend the most, but I want to get better at backend too. My goal is to become a full-stack developer who understands both the design and the code.

In my free time I work on small projects, try new things and read open-source code. I also like fiction with a good plot twist. I always try to guess the ending, and sometimes I'm right.
